name: Maya-G-M24
note: Maya-G-M with the attention projections and the shared experts in Q4_K instead of Q6_K, as Maya-S24 did for Flash: GLM-5.3 reads ~15 GB of dense weights a token in Q6_K (attn_output alone 82 MB a layer) against ~8 GB of experts, so the dense bytes set the decode speed; attn_k_b / attn_v_b stay Q6_K/Q8_0 (the pack reads them as BF16). Experts as G-M: IQ2_S gate/up, IQ3_XXS down, IQ3_S down in layers 3-6 and 74-77; NextN Q3_K/Q4_K.
